list.title: Events
list.pick: Pick an event to edit its reply.

editor.enabledHelp: An event that is off stays in the list and says nothing.
editor.messageHelp: The bot posts this in chat when the event happens.
editor.speakHelp: The reply also plays as speech on your stream.
editor.following: This event follows the platform default. Saving your own text replaces it for your channel.
editor.testUnavailable: Not available yet: the bot cannot send a test reply from here.
